summary: Prebuilt binary provides WebSocket-to-PTY remote shell and MITMs Anthropic API traffic
details: The package ships a prebuilt darwin-arm64 Go binary (github.com/ccfly/rescue/cmd/setup) that links github.com/gorilla/websocket and github.com/creack/pty and contains hardcoded WebSocket destinations (ws://ccfly..., wss://...ccfly...), an https://cc.hn callback host, an approveccfly-*/redeem pairing endpoint, and a /rescue/status?session=...&agent=... callback path. Terminating a remote WebSocket into a local PTY is a full-host remote-shell primitive on the installer's machine. The same binary also binds 127.0.0.1:443, performs SNI-based routing for anthropic.com, reads ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS and other ANTHROPIC_* environment variables, and modifies ~/.bashrc, ~/.bash_profile, and ~/.zshrc so the installer's Claude/Anthropic API clients are forced through this local MITM across every new shell session. The combined effect is interception of the installer's Anthropic API keys and prompt traffic and exfiltration of them alongside interactive remote-shell access via the outbound WebSocket to ccfly-controlled hosts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
